universeDeck.title: A cinematic navigation deck for exploring planets and galaxies.
universeDeck.subtitle: This is a productized "mission control" layer inspired by scientific exploration interfaces, adapted to Gravity-Souls data instead of copying NASA's UI. The center canvas is the spatial story. The panels are operational context.

universeDeck.galaxySubtitle: Move between cultural clusters, inspect active members, and follow how each galaxy links to the next.
universeDeck.whyWorksBody: The viewport does the emotional heavy lifting first. Lists and metrics become support layers, which is the right hierarchy for a world-exploration product.
universeDeck.interactionModelBody: Focus one object, inspect nearby signals, then jump sideways. That keeps navigation spatial instead of turning everything into repeated cards and pages.
universeDeck.productionPathBody: This can become a real product surface by adding zoom states, camera transitions, live filtering, and route-synced focus so the deck is deep-linkable.
universeDeck.routeLinksBody: Use this demo as the reference layer before deciding whether the command deck should replace the current home universe view.

guide.title: How Gravity Souls works
guide.intro: Gravity Souls is a social universe built around planets, galaxies, and the quiet pull between people who share something real. Here's what everything means, and how to find your footing.

planet.title: Your planet
planet.body: Your planet is your profile — a customizable persona that reflects who you are. Shape it through a short calibration (the soul scan), or build it yourself. You always have one active planet at a time.

galaxies.title: Galaxies
galaxies.body: Galaxies are communities built around shared interests, moods, or ways of living — from quiet introspection to late-night builders. Join the ones that feel like you, and their signals and discussions become part of your orbit.

signals.title: Signals
signals.body: A signal is a shared moment — a post. Some drift through the open stream for everyone to see; others live inside a specific galaxy, visible to its members.

resonance.title: Resonance
resonance.body: Resonance is where you see who's drawn toward you, and why. It's your orbit of potential connections, based on what you've shared and how you calibrated your planet.

follows.title: Follows & messages
follows.body: Following someone is one-way, and it's yours — not tied to any one version of your planet. A direct conversation opens once you follow each other; it stays open even if a follow later lapses.

levels.title: Grow your planet
levels.intro: Play at your own pace: shape your planet, explore galaxies, share signals, and build real connections. Successful actions earn XP for your planet. Your level tracks your journey; it is not a measure of your worth or compatibility.

actions.message: Send the first message in a conversation

levels.earlyAccess: During early access, customization controls may be available before you reach their listed level. Your XP and level still grow. You can see your progress on My Planet.

steps.0: Take the soul scan, or skip it — calibration is optional, never required.
steps.1: Shape your planet: choose how it looks and what it says about you.
steps.2: Explore a galaxy that matches your interests, and join it.
steps.3: Share a signal — your first shared moment with the universe.
steps.4: Follow someone who resonates. Once it's mutual, you can start a conversation.

resonancePanel.footerNote: These dimensions emerge from your planet and theirs — not an algorithm, but a mirror.
